contract.intent: Validate the local Sezzle calculator artifact, its real Go endpoint, React UI, Docker packaging, documentation, and evidence for the current source revision.

outcomes.statement: Exact calculator behavior and stable error handling are covered by deterministic tests.
The real Go service responds to health and calculation requests with the documented contract.
The real browser flow is checked at mobile and desktop sizes and awaits human visual approval.
The application builds and starts through Docker with frontend-to-API wiring.
The approved scope, contract, design, threat model, decisions, and AI prompt log are present and consistent.

cli.reason: The product has no CLI surface.

mcp.reason: The product has no MCP surface; MCP is outside the take-home scope.

database.reason: The approved product is stateless and has no database.

checks.command: cd backend && go vet ./... && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run build

tracking.reason: The user approved local implementation only; no external issue, PR, upload, or submission is authorized.
